records.title: Steering Recurrent Reasoners at Inference Time with Readout Feedback
records.reason: RoFB steers recurrent latent reasoning at test time without retraining and reports gains at comparable or lower FLOPs, but experiments cover AKOrN/ItrSA++/TRM on Sudoku and Maze rather than decoder LLMs; transfer to LLM inference is unresolved.

records.title: The Von-Neumann State-Space Transformer for neural decoding
records.reason: VN-SST reports parameter efficiency on two small language-modeling benchmarks, while its primary evaluation centers on neural decoding and does not establish inference latency, compute, or memory savings for LLMs.

records.title: BanglaMamba: Exploring State Space Models for Bangla Fake News Detection
records.reason: BanglaMamba reports 2.2x throughput and 49% lower peak GPU memory for Bangla fake-news classification, but has lower Macro-F1 than BanglaBERT and weaker cross-dataset generalization; this is task-specific classification, not generative LLM serving.
